name: TDspMidiLoop
description: Beat-aware MIDI loop recorder + player. tdsp::MidiLooper is a MidiSink that captures the arp's baked output, locks the loop to the master Clock downbeat (2/4..7/4, 1/2/4/8 bars), and plays it back synced with seam-wrapped note-off tails. Replace + overdub. Distinct from the audio-sample TDspLooper.
